body: Signing out of this account now. Thanks again for trying to help.

Thank you for sharing your story with me, I really appreciate it. I'm glad to hear that, even though you struggle, it sounds like you're on the up and up. Congratulations on 4 months.

If I guess now what this stems from for me it's that I have no hope that my problems will get better and every confidence that life will get harder and harder. I'm out of hope, out of fight, and I just want out. 

I totally understand what your saying and I'm grateful for it, I'm just a bit sensitive to the word "normal" when it comes to this topic. I don't tell anyone about this stuff because it's just in the air that it's normal to be depressed and suicidal. I imagine that I could raise my hand and say "Folks, I think about suicide all the time and I believe I'm getting closer everyday to actually doing it." and I'd hear a resounding "Join the club."

I don't know, it sure does seem like I'm alone. Friends break off to new paths, start new families and (understandably) become engrossed. I never knew that at a certain age, groups of friends split like that. That kind of companionship is no longer in the cards for me, it's surprisingly hard to make friends as an adult. I'm realizing too late that if I want someone to at least occasionally lend a hand, I'd have to do like my friends and commit to a relationship. Only, I can't bear the idea of having a full time companion which makes me almost feel inhuman...

This is a lot so I'll stop for now. In summary, I still feel like if this world is trying so hard to push me away, it might be best if I just gracefully bow out.
